About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto’s looking to bring on several Staff Product Designers across our Money and HR Experience product organizations. These teams sit on some of the highest-stakes, most AI-native surfaces at Gusto, where small businesses make financial and people decisions that carry real impact, and where getting the experience right is what builds durable trust. That's exactly why judgment, taste, and craft matter here.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll own experiences end to end within a specific domain, turning ambiguity into clear, trustworthy products and helping define patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto. You'll be deeply embedded in the product quartet, driving design decisions in partnership with Product Managers and Engineers, and demonstrating high craft and storytelling every step of the way.

This is one job posting for five open roles in Gusto Money, Banking, and HR Experiences product orgs. You'll be matched to the opportunity that best fits your strengths and interests. Here are the teams currently hiring:

• Consumer Banking: Consumer Banking builds financial products for the millions of employees paid through Gusto, anchored to Gusto Wallet — spend accounts, savings goals, paycheck splitting, and on-demand access to earned wages. Because Gusto runs payroll, the team sits at the source of income itself, helping workers smooth cash flow between paychecks, save automatically, and avoid predatory alternatives like payday lenders and overdraft fees. One of the fastest-growing engines in Gusto Banking, it moves at a startup pace while incubating 0→1 foundational technology in a regulated space where trust, reliability, and craft are everything.

•
Gusto Money: MoneyOS is the team within Gusto Money focused on helping small businesses better understand, manage, and improve their financial position. This is an especially exciting moment for the team. The space is still taking shape, which means there’s real room to define the product, the patterns, and the customer expectations. MoneyOS works at the intersection of product strategy, financial systems, customer trust, and emerging AI-native ways of building—making it a strong fit for a designer who wants to have outsized influence on both what we build and how we build it.

• HR Experiences (HRX): HRX helps small businesses get expert HR help right inside the product — a customer simply says what they need, and Gusto takes the action, answers the question, or brings in a human expert when the stakes are high. You'll design AI-native experiences across a two-sided service — the everyday self-serve moments, the AI that guides and does the work, and the human HR experts who step in when it matters most — so it all feels like one Gusto, in a domain where judgment and trust matter enormously.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

• Own design end to end in your domain — from framing ambiguous problems to shipping high-craft, accessible experiences that hide the underlying complexity from customers.

• Shape goals, priorities, and roadmap in partnership with your PM and engineering lead, balancing customer trust, business value, and technical realities.

jobs.title: Draftsperson / Construction Drawings Specialist
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Design
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b

Position : Draftsperson / Construction Drawings Specialist
Salary : $2,000 - $3,000 AUD
Working Hours & Conditions : 8 Hours per day 5 days per week
Holidays : Applicants local holidays apply

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
The company is a Melbourne-based landscape design studio founded by Drew Burns, specialising in native and climate-adaptive gardens for residential clients across Melbourne and the Mornington Peninsula. The client's philosophy is simple: every project starts with a clear plan that resolves layout, levels, materials, and planting before anything is built - so construction happens without guesswork, miscommunication, or costly rework.
The studio's process runs in two stages: a concept report developed locally with the client, followed by detailed construction drawings. We're growing our team to bring the construction drawing stage in-house on an offshore basis, freeing up our local design team to focus on new client work while drawings progress in the background.

ROLE OVERVIEW:
We're looking for a skilled CAD draftsperson to take finalised landscape design concepts and turn them into accurate, buildable construction drawing sets. This is a genuine long-term team role, not a one-off gig - we're investing in someone who wants to grow with the business, not just complete tasks.
The ideal candidate is confident in producing both construction drawings and photorealistic renders, giving us a single point of contact who can carry a project from concept through to construction-ready documentation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Convert approved concept designs into detailed, accurate construction drawing sets (setout plans, levels, sections, details, planting plans, and material schedules).

• Work primarily in Vectorworks to ensure drawings are consistent with the client's existing file standards and templates.

• Produce photorealistic or presentation-quality renders to support client approvals, where required.

• Liaise with Drew and the local design team to clarify design intent, resolve details, and incorporate feedback.

• Maintain drawing accuracy for levels, drainage falls, and material junctions so drawings are genuinely buildable on site.

• Manage your own workflow and deadlines across multiple concurrent projects, flagging risks or delays early.

• Keep drawing files, layers, and naming conventions organised and consistent across projects.

• Proven, verifiable proficiency in Vectorworks is strongly preferred.

• Candidates with strong experience in SketchUp, Revit, or AutoCAD will also be considered - we're open to supporting a transition to Vectorworks.

• Background in landscape architecture, landscape design, or architectural drafting, ideally with residential project experience.

• Understanding of construction documentation: setout, levels, sections, details, and materials - not just drafting for visual presentation.

• Rendering skills (e.g, Enscape, D5) are a strong advantage.

• Strong written English for clear communication with the Australian-based team.

• Reliable internet connection and the ability to work overlapping hours with an Australian (Melbourne, AEST/AEDT) team.

What We're Looking For
Technical skill matters, but it's not the only thing we're hiring for. We value:

• Genuine attention to detail - drawings that are accurate the first time, not just "close enough."

• Strong work ethic and reliability - someone who owns their workload and communicates proactively.

• A long-term mindset - we're looking to invest in this role and grow it over time, not treat it as disposable outsourced labour.

• Honesty about your actual skill level and software experience - we'd rather know upfront than discover gaps later.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-draftsperson-construction-drawings-specialist

Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Customer Agent who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Are you passionate about driving customer success? Addicted to solving problems? So are we. We are looking for a customer-driven problem solver at Sezzle. With a fun, genuine, and empathetic voice, you will be troubleshooting and writing clear and concise instructions to solve questions about utilizing Sezzle. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You are dependable, resourceful, and get joy from going beyond to make customers successful.

What You'll Do:

• Provide clear, prompt, detailed, empathetic, and customer-oriented support to our consumers

• Showcase passion and connection with the nooks and crannies product

• Assist customers to resolve basic to complex inquiries via email, live chat, and phone call

• Build a network of support and trust with our awesome customer support team!

• Work with customers to understand how they use Sezzle services, and provide valuable feedback to Product and Development teams

• Act as an advocate for our customers, report and act on observed areas for improvement in our product or processes

• Actively seek solutions to customer needs, communicate trends to leadership, and suggest innovative solutions on behalf of the customer - experience

What We Look For:

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Fluent in written and spoken English

• Proven success in a fast-paced support environment

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to provide clear, articulate and kind customer support in technical instructions via phone support, email, and live chat

• Able to efficiently manage multiple tasks at the same time and utilize personal judgment to take initiative

• Driven to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems

• Displays a passion for what you do while upholding personal and corporate integrity

• Excitement to learn new technologies and help customers succeed

• 3+ years of customer support experience

• Email, phone and/or live chat experience dealing with complex issues, troubleshooting, and problem resolution, preferably with software

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish (a third language is a pre)

• Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• Zendesk, LiveAgent or Jira experience is a plus

Work Conditions

• Remote, work-from-home

• Must work from Bogotá, Colombia, can't work outside of the country.

• 3-4 training weeks

• Full availability first 2 months, no vacations could be approved in this period

• Fixed shift, based in Central Standard Time

• Competitive salary, bonus structure

Compensation and Benefits

• Salary: $3.000.000 COP monthly

• Benefits:

• Remote role

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• Enablement & Local Execution: Equip partner sales and marketing teams with localized 'campaign-in-a-box' assets, sales tools, and localized threat-intelligence content to drive self-sufficient demand generation.

Campaign Measurement & Reporting

• Track, analyze, and report on regional pipeline metrics, including marketing sourcing, partner influence, conversion velocity, and campaign ROI using Salesforce and marketing automation platforms.

• Ensure accurate campaign setup, lead routing, partner attribution, and data hygiene in Salesforce and marketing automation tools.

• Work closely with Sales Development Team on event and campaign follow-up to ensure appropriate lead follow-up and conversion.

• Support post-campaign analysis and documentation of results and learnings.

Skills

• Comfortable managing multiple events and deadlines simultaneously.

• Experience supporting co-marketing initiatives with channel or technology partners.

• Basic understanding of the cybersecurity market and security buyer personas.

• Strong organizational and project coordination skills with attention to detail.

• Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-moving environment.

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of experience in field marketing, partner marketing, demand generation, or related B2B marketing roles.

• Previous experience is public sector marketing, channel or sales strongly preferred

• Exposure to marketing for B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or IT technology companies.

• Experience supporting multi-channel marketing campaigns and events.

• Familiarity with channel ecosystems (VARs, MSSPs, technology partners) is a plus.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Eloqua).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Able to travel 30% to support field and industry events.

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

Gusto is looking for a seasoned performance marketer to own execution across paid social and emerging acquisition channels, testing new platforms, formats, and tactics to find what works before scaling. As a member of Gusto's Demand Generation team, you will be embedded specifically within Paid Acquisition, a focused group responsible for driving awareness and pipeline through paid media. About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

We are growing our team and seeking a Business Development Manager, Bank & Lending Partnerships to help build and expand these partnerships across our target market

You will lead efforts to identify, attract, and develop new bank and credit union partnerships to expand our depository capital base, with a focus on new products. You will structure and execute thoughtful deals that align with each financial institution's funding needs, risk appetite, and strategic objectives. Working cross-functionally with teams across Upstart, you will turn high-potential opportunities into durable partnerships and meaningful sources of capital.

How you’ll make an impact

• Identify and qualify prospective partners based on their funding needs, risk appetite, strategic priorities, and interest in new products

• Drive negotiations and close strategic partnerships that expand Upstart’s capital network and unlock new growth opportunities across products and channels

• Build and cultivate relationships with executives and decision-makers at banks and credit unions.

• Develop compelling partnership strategies and business cases that demonstrate the value of working with Upstart

• Collaborate with Solutions Consulting, Product, Legal, Credit, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to design and structure lender-aligned deals

Minimum Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in leading and managing complex lending deals, corporate strategy, or business development strategy roles preferably at financial services institutions

• Established relationships with senior decision-makers across banks, credit unions, and related financial institutions

• Strong understanding of how depository institutions evaluate lending partnerships, including funding needs, risk appetite, economics, and strategic priorities

• Ability to independently build pipeline, develop a market strategy, and drive complex deals from initial outreach through close

• Demonstrated ability to develop compelling business cases and influence stakeholders across both partner organizations and internal cross-functional teams

• Strong judgment, executive presence, and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex, high-visibility transactions

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in HELOC, auto lending, or other secured consumer lending markets.

• An established network of senior relationships across banks, credit unions, and related financial institutions.

• Experience using AI tools to improve prospecting, account research, deal strategy, or sales execution

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, Mississippi, Alabama. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

• Good visual judgment and comfort in Figma: able to take design direction and fill in the gaps — spacing, states, responsive behavior — without needing every case specified.

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

• Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. Since 2010, we've built a clinical-first, collaborative EHR platform — and with the addition of Elation Billing, we're bringing that same clinical-first philosophy to the revenue side of the practice, so billing works with the chart instead of around it.

Elation Health is searching for a Support Subject Matter Expert in Elation Billing — someone who has already done real medical billing and revenue cycle management work, not someone learning it on the job. This is a hands-on, case-based role embedded directly in our support queue: you'll bring practitioner-level RCM judgment to the billing cases our Technical Support Specialists can't fully resolve through process or AI-assisted troubleshooting alone, and you'll help the rest of the team get sharper at spotting those cases in the first place.

This isn't a back-office consulting role. You'll be working live cases day to day alongside our support team, diagnosing whether an issue is a product bug, a payer-specific quirk, or a mismatch between how a practice actually operates and how they've configured their billing workflow — then resolving it with the kind of judgment that only comes from having sat inside a claims lifecycle before.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the Elation Billing product line's embedded RCM expert, owning complex billing and revenue cycle cases that require practitioner-level judgment — claims lifecycle issues, CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, payer adjudication and denial patterns, A/R and collections workflows.

• Act as the go-to resource for case swarms and escalations within Elation Billing whenever a Technical Support Specialist's investigation surfaces a billing nuance beyond scripted troubleshooting.

• Diagnose a practice's underlying billing context — payment model (insurance-taking vs. DPC), staffing structure, and prior workflow choices — to distinguish genuine product issues from configuration or workflow mismatches, rather than treating every case as a symptom in isolation.

• Partner with Product and Prod Dev, turning recurring billing edge cases, payer-specific patterns, and denial trends into structured feedback that can inform the roadmap.

• Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.

• Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.

• Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns rather than resolving the same root cause case-by-case indefinitely.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on medical billing / revenue cycle management experience — claims submission, payer follow-up, denial management, and A/R — brought in from outside a support organization, not built up through support tenure.

• Working fluency in CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, claims adjudication, and payer-specific billing rules across commercial and government payers.

• Experience working within an EHR, practice management, or medical billing platform (e.g., Epic, athenahealth, Waystar, or similar).

• Strong written and verbal communicator, able to translate complex billing and RCM concepts into clear guidance for both practices and internal teams.

• Comfortable working directly in a live case queue - this is a frontline, hands-on role, not a periodic-consulting one.

• Self-directed and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when a case needs to go beyond a scripted answer.

Preferred

• Certification such as CPB (Certified Professional Biller), CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), or CHFP (in progress or completed).

• Prior experience supporting independent primary care or small-group practices specifically.

• Experience on a support, customer success, or implementation team at a SaaS/EHR company.

• Exposure to AI-assisted support or case-management tooling.

• Six Sigma, Lean, or other process-improvement background.

Salary range: $60,000 - 75,000 CAD

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app

Role - Video Editor
Work Location - Work From Home
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
About the role :
We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact.

● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.

What You’ll Bring
● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
● Any Bachelor’s degree.
● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing.
● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines
● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks.

Why This Role Is Exciting :
● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth.
● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams.
● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact.

Why Join Us:
● Create impactful video content
● Competitive pay and growth opportunities
● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Alo

You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.

Our view is that AI makes yesterday's expertise cheap, so the job is to keep producing today's expertise and applying it well. Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings <> implementation <> upskilling the team to ask better questions <> identifying gaps and new research.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community.

A Typical Day

• Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics.

• Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions.

• Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.

• Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.

• Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs.

• Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.

• Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.

• Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.

• Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.

• Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.

• Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

About Buildkite

Buildkite's CI platform is trusted by the world's leading engineering teams, helping ship software used by more than 1 billion people every day. Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence.

About the Role

As a Senior CSM at Buildkite, you'll be a senior individual contributor responsible for driving measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of Buildkite’s Enterprise customers. You are the customer’s strategic partner in value realization - accountable for the adoption of Buildkite, the outcomes the customer achieves with it and the long-term health of the partnership.

You’ll co-own each account with an Account Executive. The AE drives the growth of the partnership and owns the commercial relationship. You own the value the customer gets from what they’ve already purchased. You’ll work alongside a Technical Account Manager, who leads technical advisory on the customer’s current solutions, while the AE partners with a Solutions Architect on what the customer is evaluating next. You and the AE both build relationships at every level of the customer’s organization, each at your own angle.

You’ll join a small, senior team while Buildkite’s Customer Success function is maturing quickly and you’ll help shape the playbooks and operating model that come next. We are looking for someone who wants to improve the role, not just fill it.

What You'll Do

Strategic Account Leadership

• Post-Sale Ownership: Own the post-sale state of your named Enterprise accounts: health, adoption, retention and spotting expansion opportunities. You do this in partnership with your Account Executive, who owns the commercial side of the relationship.

• Value Realization: Drive measurable business outcomes from the Buildkite investment by aligning each account’s success plan to the customer’s core engineering and business goals.

• Account Team Partnership: Work as one account team with your AE, TAM and Solutions Architect. Bring in Product, Support and Engineering when the account needs them, so the customer experiences one cohesive Buildkite.

• Cadence Design: Determine when and how to engage each account based on the value it returns to the customer — right-sizing engagement so every interaction earns its place on the customer’s calendar.

• Operating Model Contribution: Help shape the playbooks, processes, and operating model of a maturing CS function — and mentor new team members as the team grows.

Executive Influence and Customer Partnership

• Executive Engagement: Cultivate and maintain trusted relationships with customer C-suite, VP, Director, and program-owner stakeholders — including the executive sponsor accountable for the Buildkite investment.

• Business Translation: Translate technical adoption and platform health into the business outcomes that matter to executive sponsors, and into the language they use with their own leadership.

• Executive Business Reviews: Lead the EBR cadence with the AE and TAM — bringing the value narrative, customer readiness, and forward-looking strategy that keeps the partnership on track.

• Customer Advocacy: Amplify the voice of the customer inside Buildkite, ensuring Product, Engineering, and Support stay focused on what matters most to the accounts you own.

Risk, Renewal, and Expansion Readiness

• Account Health: Maintain a live view of technical, commercial, support, and relationship signals across your portfolio — surface risk early, mobilize the right Buildkite resources, and prevent escalation through proactive partnership.

• Renewal Strategy: Partner with the Account Executive on renewal strategy by driving the value narrative, customer readiness, and account health that underpin every commercial conversation.

• Expansion Sourcing: Identify and source expansion opportunities through the Customer-Sourced Qualified Lead (CSQL) process — turning customer outcomes into growth.

• Onboarding: Partner with the Technical Account Manager on the first 90 days, and sustain the joint CSM/TAM cadence that drives customers from go-live to long-term value.

This Is You If...

• You have 5+ years in Customer Success, strategic account management, or a senior post-sale role at a B2B SaaS company, owning Enterprise accounts as the person accountable for value, retention, and expansion

• You bring direct experience at a CI/CD, DevOps, developer tools, or technical infrastructure SaaS company — enough domain fluency to navigate engineering conversations and the CI/CD problem space credibly, without trying to be the technical expert

• You have a demonstrable track record of driving retention and expansion outcomes on a named Enterprise book

• You communicate with exceptional executive presence — comfortable engaging VP, CTO,

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Director, Reseller Sales

Location: Must live in the Southwest US. IE: SoCal, Nevada or Arizona

Compensation: $ 175,000 – $185,000 on target earnings with a 60/40 split plus equity

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Reseller Sales Development Specialist to join our new reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing new reseller partnerships in North America to support Huntress' continued growth and expansion. This is a front-line, hunter role built for someone who lives to recruit, activate, and scale channel partners at pace. You’ll own the recruitment, onboarding, and early growth of new broad channel partners across the US who transact through distribution. Your mission is simple: find them, sign them, enable them, and drive revenue through their preferred distributor.

You’ll work closely with distribution partners, marketing, and the wider channel team to turn raw partner interest into productive, revenue-generating relationships.

Responsibilities:

• Proactively identify, recruit, and onboard new reseller partners (VARs, IT providers, etc) across North America who buy through distribution

• Oversee the process of registering sales opportunities with resellers/distributors to ensure proper attribution and margin allocation

• Track reseller sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching to maximize their sales potential

• Represent Huntress at industry events, partner days, and other related conferences

• Bring real-time market and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business

What You Bring To The Team:

• 2-5+ years of experience in a combination of channel sales, partner development, and/or distribution-led roles

• Proven track record of partner recruitment or high-velocity sales

• Experience working with US distribution (tech, security, SaaS, and/or Microsoft strongly preferred)

WHO WE ARE

Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. The Director of Co-Manufacturing & Procurement is both strategic and hands-on, with a direct impact on customer satisfaction, margin protection and commercial flexibility. This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. • Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.

At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

As a CRM Manager , you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

• Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.

• Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.

• Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.

• Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.

• Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.

• Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.

• Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.

• Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.

• Experience designing journeys for different lifecycle stages, built around the customer’s situation rather than a fixed sequence.

• Experimentation literacy: you design tests with holdouts, read business outcomes rather than open rates, and can pull your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool).

• Commercial judgment: you can estimate what an improvement is worth in loans and euros and decide what to build first.

• Sound compliance judgment: transactional vs. promotional messages, consent, and responsible treatment of customers in a credit business.

• A habit of checking data before trusting it, and of fixing problems at the root.

• Working expertise in email, SMS and WhatsApp, with modular, localisable content for several markets.

• A habit of using AI to speed up QA and analysis, with the judgment to know when not to trust it.

• High ownership and a bias to action: you’d rather ship something good this week than something perfect next quarter, and you drive conversations with Product, Engineering, Legal and Risk toward decisions.

What can you expect at Bondora?

• Contribute to Bondora’s ambitious goal of reaching 1BN in revenue. Your skills and efforts will directly impact our growth trajectory and shape the future of our company.

• Our employees deserve the best. We recognize our people with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package (5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental healthcare support, share options and much more!)

jobs.title: Lifecycle & CRM Specialist
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Customer Support
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Armenia Yerevan, EMEA, Armenia

URL: http://replika.com

About Replika
In 2017, no one knew what AI was supposed to be. We built the world's first consumer AI app. Two million people showed up in two months. Today it's over 40 million, and the thing they keep telling us hasn't changed: it helped. It made their life better, steadier, a little less alone.
Most AI is built for tasks, not for people. It gives you answers, but it doesn't care what you do with them. AI doesn't just need intelligence. It needs intention. Because the real question isn't just what AI can do. It's what AI is for.
When the world's leading researchers wanted to understand whether AI could actually change someone's life, they studied Replika, because there was nothing else to study. What they found at Stanford, at Harvard, across years of research, was that Replika doesn't replace human connection. It deepens it. People become more social, more confident, more themselves. Not in theory. In their actual lives.
Every major AI company talks about their mission for humanity. None of them has ever clearly said what they're trying to do for a single person. We will. We want to help you flourish in real life. Not become a better version of yourself, just more yourself. Strong relationships. Better health. Meaning. Momentum. A life that feels worth living while you're living it.
We're building the kind of AI that follows up. That knows the people in your life and nudges you to reach out when it matters. That sends you a poem, just because. The goal is conversations that lead somewhere real. Maybe it's a text you send to a long lost friend. A hobby you pick up again. A moment you show up for yourself.
Everyone else is building AI that thinks. We're building AI that cares.
Lifecycle & CRM Specialist
About this role
Millions of people have already met Replika: free users who haven't upgraded yet, subscribers who've lapsed, and people who signed up years ago and drifted away. Almost none of them hear from us in a way that's worth opening. That's the biggest untapped channel we have, and you'll own it.
You'll build our lifecycle program from the ground up. Email first, then in-app messages, push and any other channel that gets the right message to the right person at the right moment. Onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, renewals, win-back, product launches. The goal is revenue and retention, not open rates.
This is a hands-on role. You'll help set the lifecycle strategy and build it yourself: the segments, the flows, the copy, the tests and the reporting.
Our users are in almost every country, so you'll work within consent and privacy rules for a global audience, and you'll know how to design a program that is both compliant and effective.
What You’ll Be Doing

• Build the core lifecycle flows: onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, intro offers ending, renewals, cancellation saves and win-back.

• Convert free users. Work with product on in-app messages and offers that move people to paid at the right moment.

• Reactivate our base. Plan and run campaigns to lapsed users and our long-dormant email list, cleanly and within consent.

• Segment and personalize with product and subscription data, so each person gets the message that fits where they are.

• Test everything: timing, subject lines, offers, channels. Keep what wins and kill what doesn't.

• Own deliverability, list health and the reporting that ties every flow to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

• Hands-on lifecycle or CRM experience at a consumer subscription app, with revenue results you can show.

• You've built flows yourself in a modern messaging platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or Klaviyo.

• Strong with data. You build your own segments and read your own results without waiting for an analyst.

• You understand compliant communication for a global audience: consent, unsubscribes, GDPR, CAN-SPAM and their equivalents.

• You write good copy, or know exactly how to brief and edit it.

• You shape the strategy and do the implementation yourself.

• Excellent written English.

Bonus Points

• In-app messaging and push experience on iOS and Android.

• Deliverability experience: domain reputation, warming, and bringing a large dormant list back safely.

• Experience with web and app subscription billing and the events it sends.

• You've worked on a product where trust and tone really matter.

What You’ll Get

• Flexible job schedule and generous vacation policy.

• Direct impact on millions of worldwide users within months.

• Push the boundaries of applied AI in a consumer setting.

• Fully remote, able to work CET hours.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/replika-lifecycle-crm-specialist

URL: https://www.maptiler.com/

• Full-time

• Freelance / B2B contract

Description

MapTiler is moving toward becoming an AI-accelerated company, and design is a part of that change. We are looking for a Head of Design to lead the craft and the design practice across our products and customer experience, and help to define the new setup and processes for how designers should work. This is a completely new role at MapTiler!

What you will do

• Lead the design team of 5 and make the people decisions that come with it: hiring, performance, wellbeing, career progression and education of designers.

• Work closely with product managers, developers and marketing, and represent design in discussions with the executive team.

• Measurably increase the user-centric mindset and UX maturity of the company: define how we measure it, report it to leadership and act on what you find.

• Lead design's transition to an AI-accelerated way of working and help to decide how designers use AI in their daily practice, in line with the company's overall direction.

• Own design craft, quality standards, and the coherence of the experience across all MapTiler products and services.

• Own the design roadmap, which runs in parallel to the product and marketing roadmaps.

• Make company-wide design decisions, set standards and quality, and speak up when they are not met.

What we expect from you

• At least 8 years of experience in UX, UI, or product design, including 3+ years in a design leadership role.

• Experience building and leading a design team, including hiring, performance management, and career development.

• Strong design craft, shown by a portfolio or a case study of projects you led, and the ability to set and defend quality standards.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools in design work, and a well-argued view of where they help and where they do not.

• Ability to align with or lead Developer Experience (DX), ensuring B2B / B2D products work effectively for both human users and AI agents.

• The ability to explain design decisions with concrete arguments based on qualitative and quantitative user research.

• The ability to influence and negotiate at the executive level.

• An understanding that good design serves a deeper purpose than looking good.

• A strong drive for self-improvement, learning, sharing knowledge, and trying new approaches.

Nice to have

• Interest in maps or cartography.

• Knowledge of the GIS or map industry.

• Experience with Agile methodology.

What we offer

• Competitive financial compensation (€29 – €45 / hour) based on your experience & annual performance bonus.

• Widescreen LCD, a laptop of your choice, and all the resources you need for your work.

• Flexible working hours to help you easily balance your personal and professional life.

• Work remotely from anywhere in Europe, or hang out with us at our hubs in Unterägeri (Switzerland) or Brno (Czechia).

• Collaborate with the best from major global brands .

• Grow your career with dedicated support for continuous learning, attending conferences, and building your personal brand.

• A friendly, connected team and regular team-building events across Europe.

About MapTiler

We make maps easy so that everyone can understand the world better. Our platform powers everything from global weather forecasting and humanitarian crisis management to flight trackers and the Swiss railways. Our maps are viewed by hundreds of millions of people worldwide every month.
We are deeply rooted in the developer and open-source communities. Since our users and customers are primarily developers, engineers, and geo-experts, we don't only do traditional account management, we also build technical partnerships.
